question: Which EV charging programs are open now?
html:
One EV charging bid on our radar is still open as of Nov 2, 2026: Cambridge neighborhood EV charging, a federal-aid job due Nov 10, 2026 (CET opportunity radar). The other EV items on the radar have passed their dates, or have no posted deadline.

Status of EV items

ProgramOwner / leadDeadlineStatus today
Cambridge neighborhood EV charging (federal-aid)City of CambridgeNov 10, 2026Open
NEVI developers' installer callMassDOT developers (Global Montello / Applegreen memo)Oct 31, 2026Closed
SRTA New Bedford DCFC installSRTAOct 9, 2026Closed
Applegreen 2026 Maine NEVI awardsApplegreenNone postedPartnership outreach, not a bid

(CET opportunity radar)

What this means for Cambridge

  • Eight days remain to the due date.
  • The radar flags federal-aid status. It also says to check MassDOT prequalification and DBE requirements now (CET opportunity radar).
  • Confirm those requirements directly with the owner. This answer does not cover compliance.

Gaps in the data

  • The radar was built on Sep 24, 2026. It may miss EV solicitations posted since then.
  • COMMBUYS, RI Purchasing and NH DAS blocked automated access. Massachusetts, Rhode Island and New Hampshire listings may be incomplete (CET opportunity radar).
  • The radar holds 86 items, and this context shows only three in full. Another EV item could be on the list without being visible here.
  • We do not know whether a reply went in on the NEVI installer call or on SRTA. Bid-log records would tell us.
  • A fresh manual pull of COMMBUYS and state DOT portals would show whether other EV programs are open now.

Where EV fits the growth plan

  • EV depot charging is one of the Phase 3 service lines meant to turn one-off bids into recurring contracts (CET growth plan).
  • The growth plan targets a ~25% recurring service mix by month 36. That figure is an assumption, not guidance (CET growth plan).
  • No revenue figure for EV charging appears in the context. Any EV share of revenue would be an est. that needs win-rate and contract-size data.

An installer partnership across NEVI states can give us a repeat pipeline of charging installs and service contracts. That recurring work is what lifts a contractor's valuation above project-only peers.

Next actions

  1. Decide on Cambridge by Nov 4, 2026, and confirm federal-aid prequalification and DBE terms with the owner.
  2. Check the bid log for the MassDOT NEVI installer call and SRTA New Bedford. If either went unanswered, contact the developers or the agency anyway.
  3. Contact Applegreen about installer work on its 2026 Maine NEVI awards. That outreach has no deadline.
  4. Re-run the opportunity radar, with a hand pull of COMMBUYS, RI and NH portals, to find EV solicitations posted after Sep 24, 2026.
